description: This file defines a PHP class 'kaiten' that provides an interface to the Kaiten REST API, including methods for initializing cURL, adding issues, notes, external links, and tags, as well as retrieving users, boards, and specific issues. It essentially acts as a client library for interacting with the Kaiten project management API.

classes.name: kaiten
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to interact with the Kaiten API, including issue management and user/board retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the kaiten class with context and optional configuration.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Initializes the cURL session with provided or default options.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Generates a URL to view a specific issue based on its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific issue from Kaiten by its ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue/card in Kaiten with provided title, description, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to a specific issue.

methods.name: addExternalLinks
methods.description: Attaches external links to a specific card.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a specific card.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves list of users from Kaiten.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Retrieves details of the current board.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the Kaiten API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and decodes the JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with cURL, handling headers and body.
